# Promobeez

> Promobeez connects local businesses with nano and micro-creators through barter deals — a coffee for a post, a haircut for a reel. No cash commissions. Made in Helsinki by Daring Spirit Oy.

Promobeez is a barter marketplace for neighbourhood businesses and creators from 500 followers. Businesses post offers (product or service in exchange for content); creators apply with real audience stats and geo. Contacts unlock only when both sides match. Creators are always free; businesses pay only to unlock more offers and contacts.

Primary market: Helsinki / Finland. App signup: https://my.promobeez.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.promobeez.com/): Product overview — how barter collabs work for businesses and creators
- [For businesses](https://www.promobeez.com/for-businesses.html): Geo-verified audiences, pricing model, creator search, FAQ for local brands
- [For creators](https://www.promobeez.com/for-creators.html): Deals from 500 followers, how to apply, platforms supported, FAQ for creators
